description: Three sine low-frequency oscillators at different phases, from one rate control, with a polyphonic output carrying all three

params.text: Sets the rate of all three oscillators, from a thirtieth of a hertz to a few hundred
Attenuates and inverts the rate jack before it is added to the rate, each volt doubling or halving it
Scales all three sines, from silence at the bottom to the full ±5V at the top
Adds a direct voltage to all three sines, from -5V to 5V

inputs.text: Sets the rate exponentially, a volt doubling it; a polyphonic cable here gives each channel its own rate and makes the three oscillators run independently

outputs.text: A sine at ±5V before the scale and offset knobs, the reference phase the other two are measured from
A sine at ±5V, about a tenth of a cycle behind the first output, despite the 120 degrees printed beside it
A sine at ±5V, about a fifth of a cycle behind the first output, despite the 240 degrees printed beside it
The three sines as one three-channel polyphonic cable

notes: it runs as soon as it is added to a patch; the rate jack is an addition to the knob rather than something it needs
the maker warns that feeding more than about three channels into the rate jack can crash Rack
